clearedSpotChecks.check: Whether an ordinary account can make itself chain owner through ArbDebug.becomeChainOwner() on Arbitrum One, Robinhood Chain and Elysium.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I reran eth_call from 0x...c0ffee01 to 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000ff on https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc, https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com and https://rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz on 2026-11-26. All three returned error -32000 "debug precompiles are disabled". ArbSys.arbOSVersion() at 0x64 returned 0x74 (116, ArbOS 61) on all three. The research file's raw/arbdebug.txt gives the same result for all four probed selectors. The privilege escalation path is closed.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Opcode handler edges in the OffchainLabs go-ethereum master and holiman/uint256 v1.3.2 (SAR, SHL, SHR, BYTE, SIGNEXTEND) against TickMath.sol:61-63, BitMath, TickBitmap, BalanceDelta and SqrtPriceMath.sol:219.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched the opSAR handler from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OffchainLabs/go-ethereum/master/core/vm/instructions.go (lines 220-234). It clears or sets all ones when the shift exceeds 256 and otherwise calls SRsh. SRsh in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/holiman/uint256/v1.3.2/uint256.go:1110-1121 uses Rsh for a non-negative value and returns all ones for a negative value when n >= 256. That is the specified result. src/libraries/TickMath.sol:61-63 uses signextend(2) and sar(255), which take the n >= 192 branch and give 0 or all ones for an int24. The battery covers the same edges on the running builds, so a source-level reading plus 230,061 live vectors agree.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Glamsterdam forward look: the EIP-7997 factory predeploy at 0x12 is not a valid hook address.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The low 14 bits of address 0x12 set bit 1 (AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG, src/libraries/Hooks.sol:46) and bit 4 (AFTER_DONATE_FLAG, Hooks.sol:42) and leave bit 10 (AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG, Hooks.sol:33) clear. isValidHookAddress returns false at Hooks.sol:113-116, so initialize rejects it as a hook. I did not refetch EIP-7997 to confirm the predeploy address is 0x12. arbOSVersion is 116 on all three chains, so no such change is active today. The priority gas auction item was also checked: https://docs.arbitrum.io/how-arbitrum-works/timeboost now describes PGA with 125 ms rounds replacing Timeboost on Arbitrum One. Ordering cannot reach inside an unlock, which must settle every delta before it returns (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114).
